An industry in the middle 
of a profound shift 
The mobility industry in undergoing many 
shifts. The automobile is no longer defined 
primarily by hardware. It is increasingly 
becoming a software and an AI-defined 
product. Our clients, the largest mobility 
companies in the world, are restructuring 
themselves around that reality. OEMs 
are operating in an environment amid 
rising competitive pressures, particularly 
from China, and heightened geopolitical 
uncertainty. Over the last six months, these 
challenges have been further accentuated by 
supply chain disruptions, and softer market 
demand in several regions.

continue to rise, OEMs need trusted partners 
who can manage the full mobility technology

FY 2025-26 : A Year of Resilient Progress 
FY26 was a year of resilient, quality-led growth. 
Revenue grew 4.8% in dollar terms to USD 724.8 
million and 10.5% in rupee terms, supported by strong 
momentum in Trucks & Off-Highway and cloud-based 
connected services. We also closed the year with 
a strong fourth quarter despite a muted industry 
environment.
We held our profitability steady while continuing to 
invest. EBITDA margin remained strong at 20.8%, even 
as we increased technology investments to over 5% 
of revenue. New deal wins remained healthy, and 
solutions and products now account for 21% of our 
pipeline, reinforcing the strategic pivot underway.
We enter FY27 in a turbulent environment. While two 
of our largest software-defined vehicle programs are 
winding down in the first half, we expect the revenue 
drop to be made up to some extent by growth in newly 
acquired accounts, with solid momentum from Trucks 
& Off-Highway, India and China. We are committed to 
investing in AI, solutions, products, and competencies 
to strengthen our long-term competitiveness. As a 
result, profitability may remain within a narrow range 
in the near-term, but we believe these investments are 
essential to build a stronger foundation for sustainable 
growth, and value creation over the years ahead.
Building Enduring Leadership
Two years ago, we made a deliberate decision to make 
KPIT a more resilient organization, one built to keep 
growing through disruption rather than be knocked off 
course by it.
We have focused on three priorities: deepening 
client relationships through greater ownership of 
complex programs and outcome-based engagements; 
scaling AI-led solutions and products that drive 
differentiation; and building a strong ecosystem of 
technology partners across chip to cloud. Today, 
more than 70% of our new contracts are fixed-price, 
reflecting the strength of this approach.
At the centre of this strategy is Beacon, our mobility 
intelligence product for AI-first development, 
integration, and validation. Built on insights from more 
than 2,000 production programs, Beacon enables 
enterprise-scale AI deployment with the reliability 
required for safety-critical mobility. We continue 
to build these capabilities organically and through 
focused acquisitions which our clients will need 
increasingly in the future.

Looking Forward with Confidence
I have long believed that companies which consistently 
build technology leadership ultimately build enduring 
business leadership. Mobility has reinvented itself 
repeatedly over the last century. Every transformation 
has rewarded those willing to build ahead of change 
rather than react to it. Over the medium term, we 
expect solutions and products to contribute an 
increasing share of revenue, per-person value to 
improve, and profitability to strengthen.
Over the last three decades, we have experienced 
and successfully navigated multiple disruptions, 
each bringing its own challenges. These experiences 
have reinforced our belief that resilience is built 
during periods of uncertainty, not stability. What 
has remained constant is our ability to adapt, 
communicate transparently, make difficult decisions 
when necessary, and continue investing in the future. 
That experience gives us confidence that periods of 
uncertainty are temporary, while the value created 
through technology leadership, client trust, and 
execution excellence endures.
